title: Beginner Hiker Bundle Printable, Hiking Guide + Packing Checklist + Trip Planner PDF, Gift for New Hiker, First Hike Planning Kit
description:
Everything a new hiker needs, in one download: three printable guides that work together as one simple routine. $16.99 instead of $20.97 bought separately.

WHAT'S INCLUDED
- Beginner's Hiking Guide: twelve chapters, from choosing a trail and reading the weather to what to do when something goes wrong, with a first-hike checklist
- Ultimate Hiking Packing Checklist: six lists in one (day, overnight, multi-day, warm, cold, emergency kit)
- Hiking Trip Planner: one page per hike, route notes, a pre-departure check, a hike log and a season overview

WHAT YOU GET
- Each guide in US Letter, A4 and a mobile edition, one ZIP per format
- Instant download. These are digital files; nothing is shipped.
- Bonus: our free one-page Ultimate Hiking Checklist

GOOD TO KNOW
General information for day hikers; always check local conditions before you go. For personal use.

Made by HikeSupply Co., a small shop for weekend hikers. More printable hiking guides in our Etsy shop.
